instruction: In the best_awards_acl.xlsx file located on the desktop, delete any blank rows below the last data entry, keeping only the header and data rows.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: This task requires the agent to clean up empty rows in the Excel file. The original file has 5 total rows: row 1 (header), row 2 (one data entry), and rows 3-5 (empty). After cleanup, only 2 rows should remain: the header and the one data row. Verified by reading the actual Excel file: rows 3-5 contain all None values.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter function correctly counts non-empty rows: when exclude_header=False, it starts from row 1 and counts all non-empty rows including the header
For the expected result (1 header + 1 data row after cleanup), the getter will correctly return 2: row 1 (header, non-empty) + row 2 (data, non-empty) = 2 total
Metric function correctly compares the result count (2) against expected count (2) from rules, returning 1.0 on match
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies the core requirement - that empty rows have been deleted by checking only non-empty rows remain
Postconfig appropriately includes Ctrl+S to save the file before reading, ensuring fresh state
Expected value semantically correct: count=2 matches the actual result after deleting rows 3-5 (1 header + 1 data row)
